from pathlib import Path
src='''def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); bg=grid[0][0]; out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    pts={c:[(r,col) for r in range(h) for col in range(w) if grid[r][col]==c] for c in (1,6)}
    # Join pairs of 1 markers lying on a diagonal.
    ones=pts[1]
    for i,(r,c) in enumerate(ones):
        for rr,cc in ones[i+1:]:
            if abs(rr-r)==abs(cc-c):
                dr=1 if rr>r else -1; dc=1 if cc>c else -1
                for k in range(1,abs(rr-r)):
                    out[r+dr*k][c+dc*k]=1
    # Six markers define complete down-right diagonal lines.
    for r,c in pts[6]:
        start_r=max(0,r-c); start_c=max(0,c-r)
        while start_r<h and start_c<w:
            out[start_r][start_c]=6; start_r+=1; start_c+=1
    return out
'''
